A sensation like being struck with a fist.

“————ah.”

The pain in my shoulder wakes me.

…My body is all here.

I can feel my arms and legs. I can hear myself breathe.

Bandages encircle my shoulder, and the bed beneath me is soft.

pages.en:
“————”

…The heat in my shoulder climbs into my head.

I shake it away and force my legs to move.

“——Is anyone… here?”

No. Of course no one is here.

I remember what Tohsaka said.

She left after saying those words. By now, she must have gone to fight alone.

“Ha——haah… ah——”

I make for the door.

I have to get outside.

I have to go out and find Tohsaka.

“Gh——”

I fall.

As I begin to topple, I seize the dressing table.

“Tch——”

…Pointless.

The dressing table comes crashing to the floor with me.

I have seen it before.

…Yes. It was like this that night too.

The night Lancer stabbed me through the chest.

I suffered a mortal wound, then found it healed without knowing how.

When I dragged my listless body from the corridor, I remember gathering something from the floor.

“…Right. This is just like the one from that night.”

I understand, yet my thoughts refuse to come together.

The event I had convinced myself was a dream.

Whose Servant had been fighting Lancer that night?

Who could have saved me as I lay dying? Who had a reason to be there?
